nodes.label: rhi::Device
nodes.rationale: Built-in pipelines rather than general command lists keep the interface small across three backends.

nodes.label: script::Graph (shared node graph model)
nodes.rationale: One data model and canvas serves visual scripts, sound cues, material graphs and behaviour trees.

nodes.label: Jolt Physics small API (bodies, CharacterVirtual)
nodes.rationale: No Jolt headers outside src/, keeping the dependency private to the module.

nodes.label: Render layer (mesh data, built-in shapes, grid)
nodes.norm_label: render layer (mesh data, built-in shapes, grid)

nodes.label: Data-oriented design
nodes.rationale: Entities are handles, components plain structs in packed arrays, systems loop over arrays; no inheritance in gameplay data.

nodes.label: Hot reload everywhere
nodes.rationale: File timestamps checked about once a second; textures, materials, meshes, scripts, graphs, particles, tables reload live.

nodes.label: GUID .meta sidecars
nodes.rationale: References between assets are GUID strings, so renames and moves never break them.

nodes.label: Text source, compiled on demand (DerivedData)
nodes.rationale: Assets stay readable in Content/; slow-to-read data compiles into DerivedData/ and recompiles when the source changes.

nodes.label: Visual scripts compiled to Lua
nodes.rationale: Each node is a code template, so a graph runs exactly like a hand-written script and the two cannot drift apart.

nodes.label: Audio (miniaudio): Sound Cues, Classes, Mixes, Submixes
nodes.norm_label: audio (miniaudio): sound cues, classes, mixes, submixes

nodes.label: Localisation (string tables)
nodes.rationale: Moved up from v2: cheaper before content grows.

nodes.label: Particle systems on CPU + Particle Editor
nodes.norm_label: particle systems on cpu + particle editor

nodes.label: Profilers: Tracy, stat unit / stat audio
nodes.norm_label: profilers: tracy, stat unit / stat audio

nodes.label: Source control in the Content Browser (Git)
nodes.norm_label: source control in the content browser (git)

nodes.label: Visual scripting (.lsdgraph compiled to Lua)
nodes.rationale: Compiled to Lua so graphs share events, timers, hot reload and errors with Lua scripts.

nodes.label: Build Lighting (Light Probes)
nodes.rationale: Without baking, Sky Light ambient is uniform so closed rooms are as bright as fields; probes record visible sky and one light bounce. Direct light and shadows stay real-time.

nodes.label: Editor Panels (Viewport, Outliner, Details, Content Browser)

nodes.norm_label: volumes (blocking, kill, trigger, audio, post process, nav mesh bounds)

nodes.label: Unreal Engine Feature Mapping
nodes.rationale: Manual is written for Unreal users; every feature is mapped to its Unreal name to ease onboarding.

nodes.label: Script Events and Messaging (broadcast, call, implements)
nodes.norm_label: script events and messaging (broadcast, call, implements)

nodes.label: Git Source Control in Content Browser
nodes.norm_label: git source control in content browser

nodes.label: UI Designer Canvas
nodes.rationale: Canvas edits are written into the code as inline style and attributes so code and canvas always agree.

nodes.label: UI Document JavaScript (QuickJS)
nodes.rationale: UI-only logic stays with the UI; functions over half a second are stopped so an endless loop cannot freeze the game.

nodes.label: Asset GUIDs in .meta Sidecars
nodes.rationale: References point at the GUID, not the file name, so renaming and moving assets keeps references working.

nodes.label: Plain-Text Assets
nodes.rationale: Levels, graphs, data assets and UI are plain text so they merge and diff in Git.

nodes.label: lsd_editor.exe (editor and game)
nodes.rationale: One exe is both editor and shipped game (-game or game.json) so the game runs exactly the editor's code paths.

nodes.label: Clean-room rule
nodes.rationale: Ideas from Bitsquid/Stingray only; never binaries, decompiled or leaked source, licensee docs or on-screen code, to keep the proprietary engine legally clean.

nodes.label: Silent automated runs (-nosound)
nodes.rationale: Test audio once reached the owner's speakers, so automated runs always pass -nosound.

nodes.label: 0-warnings build policy
nodes.rationale: Debug and Release build with /W4 and strict clang flags at 0 warnings; third-party warnings silenced where built.

nodes.label: Layered static-library modules (lsd_<name>)
nodes.rationale: Lower layers never include higher ones; each engine folder is a static library with public headers in include/lsd/<name>/.

nodes.label: Automatic GPU selection and quality presets
nodes.norm_label: automatic gpu selection and quality presets
nodes.rationale: Scores adapters and sizes memory to live VRAM/RAM budgets so the engine scales across NVIDIA, AMD and Intel GPUs.

nodes.label: Autodesk Stingray (public feature list, ideas only)
nodes.norm_label: autodesk stingray (public feature list, ideas only)

nodes.label: Live Link folder (Blender/Maya re-export)
nodes.rationale: File based: a DCC add-on would have to be our own code, no GPL.

nodes.label: World: generational-handle entities, packed component pools
nodes.norm_label: world: generational-handle entities, packed component pools

nodes.label: Backlog placement rule (earliest milestone whose exit test needs it)
nodes.norm_label: backlog placement rule (earliest milestone whose exit test needs it)
nodes.rationale: Features go in the earliest milestone whose exit test needs them; anything a small team does not need to ship a first game goes to v2 or Later.

nodes.label: Clean-room rules
nodes.rationale: Implement architectural ideas from public sources from scratch; never contain code or data derived from proprietary engines. LSD_Engine is proprietary, so GPL is avoided entirely and LGPL only as a separately linked library.

nodes.label: Editor-first milestone order with exit tests
nodes.norm_label: editor-first milestone order with exit tests
nodes.rationale: Each milestone ends with something runnable (its exit test).

nodes.label: Proprietary licence and third-party licence policy
nodes.norm_label: proprietary licence and third-party licence policy
nodes.rationale: All rights reserved; never GPL, LGPL only as a separately linked library, so the engine can stay closed.

nodes.label: Editor-first workflow (Unreal-style)
nodes.rationale: Content is wired up by clicking in editors; code is only for new behaviour, never for hooking up content.

nodes.label: Reflection drives tools
nodes.rationale: A struct is declared once; Details panel, file format, undo, Lua access and Play copies come from generated type info.
